title: Pullback and differentiation commute in a calculation
promptMarkdown: For $F(r,\theta)=(r\cos\theta,r\sin\theta)$ on $(0,\infty)\times\mathbb R$ and $\eta=x\,dy-y\,dx$, calculate $F^*\eta$, $d(F^*\eta)$ and $F^*(d\eta)$. Evaluate the integral of $\eta$ around the positively oriented circle of radius $R$. State why the pullback calculation does not create a globally defined angle function on the punctured plane.
hintLadder: Substitute the two coordinate differentials before expanding.
The domain of F remembers the angle lift.
